population.span: in a heterogeneous population of critically ill adults

endpoint.span: The primary outcome is death from all causes within 90 days after randomisation.

estimate.span: Death within 90 days after randomization occurred in 530 of 2433 patients (21.8%) in the BMES group and in 530 of 2413 patients (22.0%) in the saline group, for a difference of -0.15 percentage points (95% confidence interval [CI], -3.60 to 3.30; P = 0.90).

ci.span: Death within 90 days after randomization occurred in 530 of 2433 patients (21.8%) in the BMES group and in 530 of 2413 patients (22.0%) in the saline group, for a difference of -0.15 percentage points (95% confidence interval [CI], -3.60 to 3.30; P = 0.90).

treatment_strategy.span: Each study participant will receive either Plasma-Lyte 148 or 0.9% saline alone for all resuscitation episodes and for all compatible intravenous crystalloid therapy while in the ICU (for up to 90 days).

follow_up.span: The primary outcome was death from any cause within 90 days after randomization.

absent_reason.analysis_set: The statistical analysis plan states that analyses will be conducted on an intention-to-treat basis, with consent-related exclusions and no imputation in the primary analysis. The held results abstract does not explicitly identify the analysis population actually used for this estimate; planned methods do not establish execution.

served_mismatch: The served arm-level counts match the reported 90-day mortality counts. However, served_estimand is HR, whereas the reported estimate and confidence interval are a risk difference in percentage points. Neither an HR nor an RR with its confidence interval is reported in the held results. The served intention-to-treat label is supported as a planned analysis principle, but is not explicitly confirmed for the reported estimate.

entry_population_matches_question.why: The trial entry population comprises critically ill adults requiring fluid resuscitation, within the question's population.
entry_population_matches_question.span: in a heterogeneous population of critically ill adults

notes: Population, endpoint and treatment details are supported by the held full-text statistical analysis plan; observed results are bound from the abstract. The confidence interval belongs to the reported risk difference, not to an RR derived from the counts. No registry span was needed.
